requirements.title: 21-day wait after a primary or lapsed rabies vaccination
Rabies antibody titre (RNATT ≥ 0.5 IU/mL), ≤12 months before travel
MOCCAE Model Veterinary Health Certificate (USDA-VS endorsed, ≤10 days)

manual_checklist.title: Apply for the MOCCAE import permit
manual_checklist.detail: Online via the ministry portal before arrival. Pay the fee and keep the permit (copy presented on arrival). The permit is valid for 30 days — apply close enough to travel that it hasn't lapsed, but early enough to clear before departure. Pets fly as manifested cargo.

manual_checklist.title: Animals must be at least 15 weeks old
manual_checklist.detail: Younger pets are refused. (This is 15 weeks, not 4 months — the rabies vaccination + 21-day titre timing pushes the practical minimum higher.)

manual_checklist.title: Parasite treatment within 14 days, recorded on the certificate
manual_checklist.detail: Internal + external parasite treatment within 14 days of travel, noted on the MOCCAE health certificate.

manual_checklist.title: Annual import quota: max 2 pets
manual_checklist.detail: MOCCAE limits non-commercial pet imports to 2 animals per person per year.

manual_checklist.title: Check the banned-breeds list
manual_checklist.detail: Pit-bull-type breeds and some others are refused entry to the UAE. Owner-side check before booking.
